title: Methods that connect evidence, cost, and outcomes

cards.title: Economic Evaluation
cards.description: Cost-effectiveness and value assessment of medicines, vaccines, and health interventions in Korean and global decision settings.

cards.title: Evidence Synthesis
cards.description: Systematic reviews and Bayesian network meta-analysis to compare treatment options when direct evidence is limited.

cards.title: Real-World Data
cards.description: Big-data analysis and pharmacoepidemiologic studies that examine utilization, outcomes, safety, and costs in routine care.

cards.title: Disease Areas
cards.description: Applications include breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, heart failure, and vaccine policy.
